text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Is it time yet? For the race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Too long. I can't wait. My legs are 
itching to run this much, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I really feel like I can hit top speed 
today. I can't just sit still in a place 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go! Hurry, hurry! Quickly!!
